base: Create ONE original finished haunted Victorian mansion room background for an elevated three-quarter 2D adventure game. First reference is the furnishing and door-position diagram, not a picture to copy literally; second reference is ONLY the shared pixel-art rendering style, stone and carved wood materials, blue shadow/warm candle lighting and camera. Repaint the diagram into richly shaded crisp pixel-art with readable floor, furniture depth and consistent adult-sized furniture. Preserve the first guide's room boundaries, furniture group locations and required cyan exit positions. Cyan lines are REQUIRED OPEN INTERIOR DOORWAYS at those exact wall locations, including side-wall and foreground exits; no extra exits. Show side doors as readable cutaway wall openings. A south exit must be a break in the low cutaway foreground wall; otherwise keep foreground boundary continuous. Add tasteful wall portraits, lamps, side windows and decoration where they do not obstruct doors. Keep central walking routes and room-to-room access clear. Tables and chairs must read as coordinated usable groups, rather than unrelated scattered props. Chairs face their table. Furniture may be tidied slightly to make believable seating; do not move exits. No people, guests, bodies, weapons, loose evidence, blood, UI, markers, grid, text, labels or watermark. Do not retain diagram colors or words. One opaque 4:3 landscape room, ideally1536x1152; no collage.
